topHot.title: connector-weatherapi
topHot.description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that reads weather data from a canister. The supported path is the `weatherapi-client` mops package (WeatherAPI.com) over outbound HTTPS, authenticated with a query-string API key. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `api.weatherapi.com` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses the non-replicated-outcall safeguard (WeatherAPI bodies carry per-request clocks and fail consensus), the generated JSON decoding, and the API-key handling. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions weather, forecast, temperature, humidity, wind, rain, snow, conditions, sunrise, sunset, moon phase, astronomy, timezone, IP geolocation, marine or tide forecasts, or location autocomplete — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a weather endpoint.
